title: NO REJOINING A RAID YOU DIED OR EXTRACTED IN
why: His ruling of 2026-10-01: a teammate who died or extracted could press JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS and go straight back into the same raid with a fresh kit, a respawn that takes the sting out of dying. Now he sits that raid out: no join button for it, the lift says he goes up with his host next time, and the host refuses it too (so a window reopened after dying cannot slip back in). A teammate who abandoned, or whose window closed or lost the link, can still join.
now: A teammate who died or extracted sits out the rest of that raid; leaving any other way (abandon, a closed window, a lost link) can still JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS.
